name: Simple Face Wash - Simple Water Boost Micellar Facial Gel Wash 150ml
description:
Simple Water Boost Micellar Facial Gel Wash – 150ml

Deeply cleanse and refresh sensitive skin with the Simple Water Boost Micellar Facial Gel Wash. Suitable for both men and women, this gentle gel wash removes dirt, oil, and impurities without stripping the skin’s natural moisture.

Key Features & Benefits:

Deep Cleansing: Effectively removes dirt, oil, and makeup while keeping skin hydrated.

Gentle on Sensitive Skin: Specially formulated for sensitive skin, free from harsh chemicals and artificial fragrances.

Unisex Formula: Suitable for both men and women.

Trusted Brand: Made by Simple in the UK, known for gentle, effective skincare solutions.

Manufacturer: Simple
Country of Origin: UK
Size: 150ml
Skin Type: Sensitive
Solution Type: Deep Cleansing

Keep your skin fresh, clean, and hydrated every day with this gentle micellar facial gel wash.
